infrastructure_services.name: Budget Enforcement Service
infrastructure_services.description: Hard-stops billable steps when the workspace usage ceiling is reached.

infrastructure_services.name: Permission Ladder Service
infrastructure_services.description: Enforces Plan → Create → Execute internally → Act externally ceilings and external-action gates.
infrastructure_services.notes: Governance rule: monitoring agents (e.g. DX-148) may advise; permission ceilings remain deterministic.

infrastructure_services.name: Audit Logging Service
infrastructure_services.description: Append-only audit trail for mission status, approvals, and usage events.
infrastructure_services.notes: Non-agent infrastructure. Agents cannot mute or rewrite audit events.

infrastructure_services.name: Mission Orchestrator
infrastructure_services.description: Owns mission state transitions, task scheduling, and dependency order.
infrastructure_services.notes: The orchestrator owns mission state; agents do not.

infrastructure_services.name: Tool Gateway
infrastructure_services.description: Validates tool allowlists, arguments, approvals, and budget before any tool call.
infrastructure_services.notes: Agents must never bypass this gateway with unrestricted credentials.
